description:
What has been recorded against a property, from the official parcel-keyed land records index, free.
        `place`: manhattan, brooklyn, queens, bronx, staten-island, philadelphia, cook (Cook County IL, Chicago),
        hamilton (Hamilton County OH, Cincinnati) or utah (Utah County UT, Provo/Orem); county or city names work too.
        `address`: street address starting with the house number; in Hamilton and Utah counties add the city after a
        comma (e.g. "851 W 300 S, Orem"), since street addresses repeat between towns.

        Returns counts of recorded documents by kind (transfers, mortgages, releases, other) and by year, document
        types, the first and latest recorded event, the transfers with date, type and recorded consideration, the
        parcel id and index searched, and building record counts where available. People's names are masked to
        initials; businesses and public bodies are shown as recorded. It does NOT say which mortgage is open or
        released (that matching is the title search report). status: 'ok', 'not_found' (no parcel matched),
        'ambiguous' (several parcels: the message lists them), 'unavailable' (the county did not answer: not 'nothing
        recorded'; retry later), 'invalid'.
name: property_history_lookup
